proposed_widenings.name: spawned_creature catalog-ref stat block source
proposed_widenings.justification: The item already fits the existing magic-item spawned-creature family, but the payload can only inline a CreatureStatBlock. This item summons a named SRD monster with its own published stat block. Inlining that monster here would duplicate data that belongs in the monster layer and still misses monster-only details like recharge actions and source-filtered resistances.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you can take a Magic action to summon an Air Elemental

proposed_widenings.name: CreatureDismissal.manualDismiss = bonus_action
proposed_widenings.justification: The spawned-creature dismissal surface only supports manual dismissal as a Magic action or never. This item grants a wielder-chosen early dismissal that specifically costs a Bonus Action.
proposed_widenings.evidence: when you dismiss it as a Bonus Action

notes: Did not author content JSON/Dhall. `magic_item` + `spawned_creature` + `standard_action: magic` + `dawn` already exist, so this is not structural. The blocking gaps are an honest named-monster summon source and Bonus Action dismissal.
